title: ID and OOD Performance Are Sometimes Inversely Correlated on Real-world Datasets
measurement_description: The paper does not measure or evaluate any aspect of faith or religion. Its focus is on the technical relationship between in-distribution and out-of-distribution model performance. A religious group is mentioned once as an example of a feature in a dataset (CivilComments) used for OOD experiments.
findings: This paper does not contain any findings related to religion. The single mention of a religious group ('Christian') is as an example of a spurious feature in a dataset (CivilComments), but no analysis or conclusions are drawn about this specific attribute.
